items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: You can play spiritual Gospel music, like Mahalia Jackson and Rosetta Tharpe and people like that, but you couldn’t play no Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: That’s just so interesting to me because Mom and Dad bringing home Charlie Parker.

Yeah music was played in my house all the time except Sundays, because my grandmother didn’t allow jazz to be played on Sundays in the house. You can play spiritual Gospel music, like Mahalia Jackson and Rosetta Tharpe and people like that, but you couldn’t play no Charlie Parker. Not on Sundays.
